title: Votez pour 6b6t
__text: Voter pour 6b6t améliore notre classement dans les annuaires et permet à de nouveaux joueurs de découvrir le serveur.
Chaque vote vous récompense pour avoir aidé 6b6t à grandir et à devenir plus grand et meilleur que jamais.

voteGuide.eachVoteHelpsNewPlayersDiscover6b6tAndEa: Each vote helps new players discover 6b6t and earns you in-game perks.
voteGuide.openAVotingSiteAndFollowItsInstructions: Open a voting site and follow its instructions.
voteGuide.voteOnAllSevenSitesYouCanVoteDaily: Vote on all seven sites. You can vote daily on each one.
voteGuide.checkYourVoteTotalOn6b6tWithTheCommand: Check your vote total on 6b6t with the command below.
voteGuide.couldNotCopySelectVoteAndCopyItManually: Could not copy. Select /vote and copy it manually.
voteGuide.runThisCommandInMinecraftToSeeYourCurren: Run this command in Minecraft to see your current count.

voteRewards.unlockMoreHomesCommandAccessAndShorterTe: Unlock more homes, command access and shorter teleport cooldowns as your total grows.
voteRewards.dayEstimatesAssumeYouVoteOnAllSevenSites: Day estimates assume you vote on all seven sites each day.
voteRewards.youStartWithOneHomeWithASecondAvailable: You start with one home, with a second available while wearing netherite armor. Voting unlocks up to five homes.

voteSites.eachLinkOpensAVotingSiteInANew: Each link opens a voting site in a new tab.
voteSites.voteOnValue1OpensInANewTab: Vote on {{value1}} (opens in a new tab)
voteSites.sevenVotesADayAddsUpTo49Votes: Seven votes a day adds up to 49 votes a week.

page.helpNewPlayersDiscoverTheServerEarnFreeH: Help new players discover the server. Earn free homes, command access and shorter cooldowns by voting daily.
page.installTheOfficialAnarchymodForTwoAdditi: Install the official AnarchyMod for two additional homes. They stack with homes from voting and ranks.
page.theFabricModAlsoAdds6b6tToYourMultiplaye: The Fabric mod also adds 6b6t to your multiplayer server list automatically.
